AWPTCM-T38767.objective:
• Selecting option 7 (Restore Bootloader factory settings) in the bootloader menu restores the bootloader settings to their factory defaults.
  • After restore, default boot source, TFTP settings, release boot file settings, developer mode, and console speed settings are reset to factory defaults.
  • The device reboots successfully with the restored default bootloader configuration.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary: AWP-2719 (Bootloader menu option 7 restore factory). Top relevant: AWP-2722 (tftp settings reset), AWP-2723 (release boot file reset), AWP-2720 (developer mode cleared), AWP-2721 (console speed reset). ART: 5700.1002.7 (bootloader version), 5700.1003.5 (ROM checksum) + related platform bootloader tests.
Set up the device to boot from TFTP by default. Reboot and confirm the setting. Reboot again and enter the bootloader menu (ctrl-B). Select option "7" to restore the Bootloader factory settings.
After restore, reboot the device and verify that bootloader settings (default boot source, TFTP, release boot file, developer mode, console speed) have been reset to factory defaults.
